fact_text: Pakistan's first phase of electricity distribution privatisation covers Faisalabad, Gujranwala and Islamabad supply companies, with Hyderabad and Sukkur to follow, aiming to cut system losses and improve efficiency.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Twelve companies and consortia bid for 51% to 100% of Faisalabad Electric Supply Company, eight of them Pakistani, three Turkish and one Chinese.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Listed Pakistani groups that registered interest in the Faisalabad distribution company include Engro Energy, a Hub Power Holdings consortium, Lucky Cement, Maple Leaf Cement, Kohinoor Textile, Nishat Mills, Shirazi Investments, Artistic Milliners and K-Electric.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst cautions that distribution privatisation sits on top of large circular-debt problems in Pakistan's power chain, and the risk is that the burden is passed to consumers through tariffs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Punjab Revenue Authority banned manual receipts for restaurants, hotels, coffee shops and marriage halls, requiring digital invoices with QR codes through an electronic invoice monitoring system, with fines and up to a month's closure for repeat non-compliance.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Punjab charges 16% sales tax on restaurant bills paid in cash against 8% on card payments, a gap deliberately used to push consumers towards documented digital transactions.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The maritime affairs ministry unveiled a 150-acre automotive processing zone at Port Qasim, to be built in phases with 264 units across commercial, refurbishment, car display, machinery and spare-parts segments.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Because it sits inside Port Qasim's industrial corridor with direct port access, the proposed automotive zone is projected to cut inland freight costs and generate a net foreign-exchange surplus near 200 million dollars on 500 million dollars of exports.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The government shelved liquidating Pakistan Steel Mills in favour of studying a revival, with a Russian industrial engineering consultancy assessing modernisation, production costs and market feasibility before the SOE cabinet committee decides.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: An earlier attempt to sell Pakistan Steel Mills found no buyer, and since then the state has carried employee salaries while bills are met by selling scrap from the idle plant.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Bank of Punjab is issuing about PKR 30 billion of shares to the Punjab government at a 5% premium under a non-rights issue, PKR 20 billion by 31 December 2026 and the balance by 30 June 2027.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pak Wins Against India, Direct Train from Russia to Pak, 150 Acre Auto Unit | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Punjab government share issue lifts the provincial stake in Bank of Punjab from 58% to 66% and cuts free float from 43% to 34%, with share count rising from 3.3 billion to 4.1 billion.

fact_text: Australia's Federal Court dismissed India's attempt to trademark the word basmati, upholding the position that it is a geographical indication no single country can claim, after a similar rejection by the trademarks registrar in December 2022.

fact_text: Pakistan, Turkiye and Saudi Arabia signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement under which an attack on one is treated as an attack on all, and the analyst expects trade and economic cooperation to deepen alongside it.

fact_text: Russia and Pakistan are working on direct rail routes from Moscow to Faisalabad and to Karachi to lift bilateral trade, a project repeatedly delayed by geopolitical tension in 2025 and 2026.
